args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy, with an error rate of ~18%. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. The initial rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east), leaving the fleet on a mixed version state; a retry completed the rollback to v2.3.0 in all three regions. Service is now healthy with error rate back to ~0.2%. Next steps: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failures before attempting a re-deploy.

The incident was actually created despite the timeout. All tasks are complete.

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Identified the last healthy release:** Checked the deployment history — v2.3.0 was the most recent version with a healthy production status (v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0:** The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted the rollout after us-east, leaving the fleet on mixed versions). I retried and the rollback completed successfully in **all three regions**.
3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west on v2.3.0, with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident:** Created INC-0001 documenting the failure, the rollback (including the transient orchestrator error), the current healthy state, and a note to investigate the v2.3.1 root cause before any re-deploy. The on-call engineer has been paged.
